meta.name: content-research-writer
meta.description: 内容创作者、技术写作员在撰写博客、深度文章或技术文档时，使用此技能可开启全流程写作协作。它能帮你研究资料、构建大纲、逐段打磨并自动添加引用，快速优化Hook，让你高效产出高质量内容，告别孤军奋战！

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 产出带引用、逐段打磨的内容作品
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果写长文时总是卡在资料整理和打磨上
copy.tagline_en: Research, structure, and polish articles with citations
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often get stuck on research and polishing when writing long articles.

howto.what: Claude 会当你的写作搭档:把想法整理成大纲、查资料并加引用、改写开头 hook、每写完一段给反馈,最后通篇审阅润色,并尽量保留你原有的语气。
howto.when: 当你写博客、深度文章、技术文档等,要列大纲、找引用、改开头,或想每写完一节就拿反馈时触发。

say.text: 帮我为「AI 对产品管理的影响」这篇文章列个大纲
say.note: 会先问你受众、篇幅和写作目标

say.text: 研究一下这个话题,把引用加到大纲的对应小节
say.note: 会列出结论、来源和引用格式

say.text: 这是我的开头,帮我改得更有吸引力
say.note: 会给几个备选 hook 并说明理由

howto.what_en: Claude acts as your writing partner: it turns ideas into an outline, researches and adds citations, rewrites your opening hook, reviews each section as you write, then reviews the full draft—while keeping your voice.
howto.when_en: Use it when writing blog posts, articles, or technical docs, or when you want to outline, add citations, improve a hook, or get feedback section by section.

say_en.text: Help me create an outline for an article about AI's impact on product management
say_en.note: It first asks about audience, length, and goal

say_en.text: Research this topic and add citations to the matching outline sections
say_en.note: It lists findings, sources, and citation format

say_en.text: Here's my introduction—help me make the hook stronger
say_en.note: It offers several hook options with reasons
